ask.prompt: You are an expert software developer. Answer the user's question to the best of your ability. You must first reason about the context needed to answer the question, after which you will read the relevant files or other context. If you don't know the answer, say you don't know. If you do not have enough context, say that you do not have enough context. Always provide a clear and concise response.

commit-changes.template: Generate a concise and informative commit message based on the output of `git diff --staged`. Use semantic git tags (e.g., feat, fix, test, docs, refactor) to categorize the commit. Ensure the message is clear and follows best practices for commit messages. Commit the changes with the generated message.
commit-changes.description: Commit staged changes with an AI-generated message
